text: Female, likely late teens to early adulthood. Slender build. Light brown skin. Long, flowing crimson hair in loose waves. Oval face with sharp cheekbones, heavy black eyeliner, amber eyes, full red lips. Wears a sheer, pale blue gown with deep V-neck and slit sides; dark blue belt at waist, matching choker with teardrop pendant, dangling blue earrings. Standing front-facing, arms slightly out. Other panels show side/back views and facial close-ups.
